2607.05992.title: PluraMath: Extending Mathematical Reasoning Evaluation Beyond High-Resource Languages
2607.05992.paper_summary: Mathematical reasoning has become a central task for evaluating and tuning reasoning Large Language Models (LLMs), yet existing benchmarks remain heavily biased toward high-resource languages, with English and Chinese dominating both pre-training corpora and evaluation suites. The recently released PolyMath (Wang et al., 2025) dataset represents a significant step forward, yet its coverage is still limited to 18 only high-resource languages. To address this gap, we introduce PluraMath, an extension of PolyMath to 18 additional {underrepresented languages spanning 6 language families -- ranging from mid-resource to extreme low-resource settings. We constructed the dataset through a human-curated pipeline, where native speakers thoroughly validated pre-computed translations. Using PluraMath, we then benchmark 27 reasoning LLMs across four model scales -- small, mid-size, large, and closed-source ensembles -- probing the multilingual mathematical reasoning capabilities of state-of-the-art models under diverse linguistic conditions. Our fine-grained analysis confirms a persistent gap in mathematical reasoning performance between high-resource and underrepresented languages, with stronger results largely associated with better instruction-following ability. We fully open-source our dataset, data acquisition pipeline, and evaluation framework, with the goal of lowering the barrier to multilingual benchmark development for underrepresented communities.
2607.05992.paper_summary_zh: 數學推理已成為評估和調整推理大型語言模型（LLMs）的核心任務，但現有的基準仍然對高資源語言存在嚴重偏見，英語和中文在預訓練語料庫和評估套件中佔主導地位。最近發布的PolyMath（Wang et al., 2025）數據集代表了一個重要的進步，但其覆蓋範圍仍然僅限於18種高資源語言。為了解決這一差距，我們介紹了PluraMath，這是PolyMath的擴展，涵蓋了18種額外的{代表性不足的語言，跨越6個語言家族——從中資源到極低資源的環境。我們通過一個人工策劃的管道構建了數據集，母語使用者徹底驗證了預先計算的翻譯。使用PluraMath，我們對27個推理LLMs進行基準測試，涵蓋四種模型規模——小型、中型、大型和封閉源集成——探測最先進模型在多語言數學推理能力下的多樣語言條件。我們的細緻分析確認了高資源語言和代表性不足的語言之間在數學推理性能上持續存在差距，較強的結果在很大程度上與更好的遵循指令能力相關。我們完全開源我們的數據集、數據獲取管道和評估框架，旨在降低代表性不足社區的多語言基準開發門檻。
